blocks.text: Sodium pani ki taraf magnesium se zyada reactive hai. Sodium pani se zor se react kar ke sodium hydroxide aur hydrogen banata hai, jab ke magnesium zyada aahista react kar ke magnesium hydroxide aur hydrogen banata hai. Magar magnesium bhaap (steam) se zyada zor se react kar ke magnesium oxide aur hydrogen gas banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Magnesium bhaap se apna oxide magar thande pani se apna hydroxide kyun deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Thande pani se sust reaction magnesium hydroxide banata hai, magar bhaap ke darja-hararat par reaction bohat tez hai aur hydroxide baqi nahin rehta; paidawar magnesium oxide aur hydrogen hai.

items: Sodium pani se: zor se, sodium hydroxide aur hydrogen. Magnesium pani se: aahista, magnesium hydroxide aur hydrogen; bhaap se, zor se, magnesium oxide aur hydrogen.
